Black Dress by the Lanterns, Looking Back

Bold, urban, candid
WORKING NOTES
- This is a near-duplicate of section 69; keep only one if you don't need
both.
- Use 'warm late-afternoon light' for a glowing atmosphere.
Try this: Use warm late-afternoon light.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black
hair and blunt bangs looks back over one shoulder
beside a red paper lantern. She wears a fitted black
sleeveless mock-neck dress with sheer panels at
the waist, and a silver bangle. Red lanterns,
weathered brick, and stone steps fill the
background. Her expression is calm and direct.
Warm, late-afternoon light. Palette of black, red,
and brick tones. Bold and urban, in the style of a
travel street-style photo.
